title: Preserve meaning and attribution across browser views
statement: The Views and traceability Module shall preserve meaning and attribution across browser views within its accountable browser contribution to SR-085, retaining the stated limits of collaborating owners.

what.problem: A locally successful browser step can hide missing ownership or an invalid cross-boundary conclusion.
what.desired_outcome: Preserve meaning and attribution across browser views.

why.rationale: MOD-004 owns the behavior necessary for the selected SR-085 criteria; the SR remains the system-wide obligation.

conditions: When generating, reading, recovering or qualifying the selected browser scope.

contexts: MOD-004 and its declared browser cooperation contracts.

how.approach: Apply the constrained Functions and preserve source, output, qualification and authority distinctions at the boundary.

how_much.scope: Contribution to SR-085 criteria 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. Other Module contributions and final product qualification remain distinct.

acceptance_criteria: Readers can navigate each available view from an overview to relevant definitions, relationships and applicable rationale, using readable labels and keyboard-accessible navigation.
Logical ownership and containment remain distinct from execution and deployment; a shared source file does not merge logical responsibilities.
Process topology does not imply execution order or concurrency. Selected activity, interaction and lifecycle details appear only where authoritative semantics establish them.
Proposed and observed facts remain distinguishable in overviews and details, even when names are identical; each detail exposes its selected-state source basis.
Scenario navigation retains stakeholder meaning and identified architecture participation without turning reachability or rendering into coverage, approval or satisfaction.
Missing required explanation and incomplete selections remain explicit; absent details are not fabricated and view success does not establish a complete design.
constraints: Draft allocation; does not establish implemented browser support or requirement satisfaction.

sources.basis: System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
